name: Tag
purpose: A short label for a topic or a filter.
whenToUse: Showing filters that can be removed

anatomy.element: a, or a button the page wires up

props.name: removeHref
props.does: Adds a remove link, which works with no script, for example a URL without this filter

props.name: onRemove
props.does: Adds a remove button the page handles; in React Server Components it needs a client component parent

keyboard.action: Reaches the remove part, if there is one
Follows the remove link, or presses the remove button

accessibility.web: Plain text. The remove part is a real link or button named Remove followed by the tag text, at the 24 by 24 pixel minimum. Prefer the link: it works with no script.
accessibility.ios: Text in a capsule; a remove Button with an accessibility label
accessibility.android: Compose InputChip with a trailing remove icon and content description

content: One or two words in sentence case: Design systems.
